s1.syndrome_frame: Postpartum headache with worsening course and associated symptoms
salient_findings: Layered hypodense crescent-shaped extra-axial collection on noncontrast CT
key_facts: 31 days postpartum after elective cesarean delivery
Initial mild global headache 8 days postoperatively
Normal prothrombin time, partial prothrombin time, and international normalized ratio
Noncontrast CT showed extra-axial collection with areas of linear and crescentic hyperdensity

raw.syndrome_frame: Postpartum headache with worsening course and associated symptoms
salient_findings: Layered hypodense crescent-shaped extra-axial collection on noncontrast CT
key_facts: 31 days postpartum after elective cesarean delivery
Initial mild global headache 8 days postoperatively
Normal prothrombin time, partial prothrombin time, and international normalized ratio
Noncontrast CT showed extra-axial collection with areas of linear and crescentic hyperdensity

differentials: Cerebral vasculitis due to systemic lupus erythematosus
Intracranial hemorrhage due to arteriovenous malformation
Cerebral venous thrombosis due to protein S deficiency
Dural sinus thrombosis with hemorrhagic transformation
Intracranial hemorrhage due to cocaine use
Intracranial dural sinus thrombosis due to factor V Leiden mutation
per_call: Cerebral vasculitis due to systemic lupus erythematosus
Intracranial hemorrhage due to arteriovenous malformation
Cerebral venous thrombosis due to protein S deficiency
Dural sinus thrombosis with hemorrhagic transformation
Intracranial hemorrhage due to cocaine use
Intracranial dural sinus thrombosis due to factor V Leiden mutation

shortlist.label: Subdural hematoma
shortlist.why_kept: Noncontrast CT showed extra-axial collection with areas of linear and crescentic hyperdensity, consistent with subdural hematoma

shortlist.label: Chronic subdural hematoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of worsening headache over 3 days, with initial mild headache 8 days postoperatively, suggests possible chronic subdural hematoma

shortlist.label: Spontaneous intracranial hypotension
shortlist.why_kept: Postpartum headache with worsening course, normal vital signs, and intact motor function, could be related to spontaneous intracranial hypotension

shortlist.label: Cerebral venous sinus thrombosis
shortlist.why_kept: Headache became severe over 24 hours, with normal complete blood count and prothrombin time, partial prothrombin time, and international normalized ratio, raises concern for cerebral venous sinus thrombosis

shortlist.label: Postpartum cerebral vasculopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Postpartum headache with worsening course, normal vital signs, and intact motor function, could be related to postpartum cerebral vasculopathy

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of worsening headache and the presence of a layered hypodense crescent-shaped extra-axial collection on noncontrast CT of the head are consistent with a chronic subdural hematoma, which can develop after a traumatic event such as a cesarean delivery, especially under spinal anesthesia.

rejected.label: Subdural hematoma
rejected.why: While possible, the chronic nature of the symptoms and the specific CT findings suggest a chronic rather than acute subdural hematoma.

rejected.label: Spontaneous intracranial hypotension
rejected.why: This condition typically presents with postural headaches, which is not the case here, and the CT findings do not support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Cerebral venous sinus thrombosis
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and CT findings do not specifically suggest thrombosis in the cerebral venous sinuses.

rejected.label: Postpartum cerebral vasculopathy
rejected.why: This condition is characterized by headaches with thunderclap onset and is often associated with other symptoms such as seizures or visual disturbances, which are not present in this case.

rejected.label: Spontaneous intracranial hypotension
rejected.why: The presence of an extra-axial collection with areas of linear and crescentic hyperdensity on CT does not support this diagnosis, which typically involves low CSF pressure without such collections.
